description: Approved portable cloud-agent checklist. Execute the complete companion plan.md; this is not input to the installed modernization executor and requires no local extension schema.

metadata.springFrameworkTarget: Spring Boot 4.1.2 BOM-managed; no independent override

tasks.description: Capture baseline and prepare isolated PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ and shared local storage
tasks.requirements: Follow plan.md section 001. Capture original-stack reactor test commands, exit codes and counts before editing. Probe cloud Docker and Node independently; do not infer availability from the planning machine. Provision only disposable, uniquely named services/test data and dev-profile local storage. Respect configured package feeds; no live AWS/Azure or production resources. Record pre-existing failures without disabling tests. If required infrastructure cannot run, document a blocker; no silent mocks/in-memory acceptance substitute.

tasks.description: Upgrade parent and web/worker to Java 25 and Boot 4.1.2 with regression tests
tasks.requirements: Follow plan.md section 002 and Testing Strategy. All four selected KB goals are consolidated and approved. Stage Java 17/Boot 2.7.18 as needed, Boot 3.5.16 on Java 17 then 25, Boot 4.0.9 on 25, and final Boot 4.1.2 on 25. Preserve Boot-managed Framework, message contracts, queues/retry/ack behavior and external integrations. Fix required Jakarta/Common Annotations, Hibernate/JPA, Jackson/AMQP, starter and build compatibility only. Retain javax.imageio. Add focused regression/context tests for both modules, wire integration and browser acceptance into Maven verify, and update directly affected CI/scripts/docs. Run affected module tests and full reactor verify at Boot checkpoints; report counts and nonzero exits honestly. No unrelated refactoring, service migration, new features, deployment or application containerization.

tasks.description: Scan final resolved dependencies and apply minimum compatible patches
tasks.requirements: Follow plan.md section 003. Scan both modules with current advisory data; record scanner/version/command/database timestamp and scope. Preserve Java 25/Boot 4.1.2/BOM alignment. Do not perform unrelated major dependency upgrades. List residual advisories, severity, affected/fixed versions and reasons. Residual findings are reported, not silently waived or suppressed; they are not an automatic zero-High/Critical gate. Unavailable scans are UNVERIFIED. Rerun affected tests and full reactor verify after patches.

tasks.description: Prove the local end-to-end flow and open one evidence-backed PR
tasks.requirements: Follow plan.md section 004 and the complete Testing Strategy. Run Maven verify on final dependencies plus the wired focused/context/integration/browser tests. Start both modules with dev profile, isolated real PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ and a shared absolute temporary storage directory. Use a unique valid 1200x800 image: real upload, original byte read-back, worker-generated decodable 600x400 thumbnail within 60 seconds, rendered gallery/detail assertions, and deletion of original/thumbnail. Also verify lifecycle initialization, JPA write/read and existing empty-upload/missing-image behavior. Use UUID data, bounded readiness/polling and scoped teardown. Capture commands/exit codes/counts, resolved versions and browser evidence. Nonzero exit is FAIL; unavailable services/browser validation are BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED, not success. Document unrelated baseline failures and leave blocked PR draft if they prevent acceptance. Open one PR against main, without merging or deploying.
